data.name: TOMISIN ADENIYI
data.summary: Data professional with 6+ years of experience in quantitative data analysis, statistical analysis, data management, reporting, visualization, and applied machine learning. B.Sc. Statistics with hands-on experience analyzing field-collected and business datasets using Python, Excel, Power BI, SPSS, SQL, and statistical methods. Experienced in cleaning and validating data, identifying patterns and trends, translating analytical findings into actionable recommendations, and communicating results to technical and non-technical audiences. Experienced in mentoring learners and analysts through structured data science projects and promoting rigorous, reproducible analytical practices. Strong analytical reasoning, evidence-based problem-solving, technical writing, and ability to work independently across multiple analytical workstreams.

experience.title: Data Science, AI & ML Mentor
responsibilities: Mentor fellows through a structured fraud detection data science capstone involving data exploration, statistical analysis, model evaluation, interpretation, and deployment.
Guide learners in applying rigorous analytical approaches to real-world datasets and interpreting results appropriately.
Review analytical work for accuracy, methodological soundness, and clarity.
Provide technical guidance and feedback to support learners' development in Python, data analysis, statistical reasoning, and machine learning.
Structure collaborative workflows using GitHub, modular development practices, and documented analytical processes.

experience.title: Data Scientist & Machine Learning Engineer (Intern)
responsibilities: Built an AI-assisted information extraction pipeline supporting regulatory compliance investigations, combining data retrieval, structured information extraction, and deterministic validation.
Processed and validated information from multiple sources to improve the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of analytical outputs.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to improve analytical and technical workflows.
Produced technical documentation supporting reproducibility, knowledge sharing, and reliable analytical processes.

experience.title: Data Scientist & Machine Learning Engineer Intern
responsibilities: Conducted quantitative analysis of complex datasets for classification and regression use cases.
Cleaned, transformed, and engineered data to improve data quality and analytical outcomes.
Applied statistical and machine learning techniques to identify patterns and generate predictive insights.
Built automated data pipelines supporting repeatable data preparation, analysis, and validation workflows.
Developed interactive Power BI dashboards and analytical reports to communicate findings and support stakeholder decision-making.
Used Python, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, and Seaborn for data analysis and visualization.
